problem_array.name: Letter_Dimensions
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that displays the dimensions of a letter-size (8.5 x 11 inches) sheet of paper in millimeters. There are 25.4 millimeters per inch. Use constants and comments in your program.

problem_array.name: Letter_perimeter
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that computes and displays the perimeter of a letter-size (8.5 x 11 inches) sheet of paper and the length of its diagonal.

problem_array.name: powerFunctions
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that reads a number and displays the square, cube, and fourth power.

dafny.method_signature: powerFunctions(x: int) returns (sq: int, cube : int, fourth: int)

problem_array.name: sum
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The sum

problem_array.name: difference
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The difference

problem_array.name: product
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The product

problem_array.name: average
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The average

problem_array.name: distance
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The distance (absolute value of the difference)

ensures: if x >= y then result == x - y else result == y - x

problem_array.name: max
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The maximum (the larger of the two)

ensures: if x >= y then result == x else result == y

problem_array.name: min
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for two integers and then prints The minimum (the smaller of the two)

ensures: if x <= y then result == x else result == y

problem_array.name: convert
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for a measurement in meters and then converts it to miles, feet, and inches.

dafny.method_signature: convert(x: real) returns (miles: real, feet: real, inches: real)

problem_array.name: circle_properties
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that prompts the user for a radius and then prints The area and circumference of a circle with that radius The volume and surface area of a sphere with that radius

dafny.method_signature: circle_properties(radius: real) returns (circumference: real, area: real, surface_area: real, volume: real)

problem_array.name: rectangle_properties
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that takes the lengths of the sides of a rectangle. Then return The area and perimeter of the rectangle The length of the diagonal (use the Pythagorean theorem)

dafny.method_signature: rectangle_properties(length: real, width: real) returns (area: real, perimeter: real, diagonal: real)
ensures: diagonal * diagonal == length * length + width * width

problem_array.name: hybrid_car_cost
problem_array.nat_lang_statement: Write a program that helps a person decide whether to buy a hybrid car. Your program's inputs should be: The cost of a new car The estimated miles driven per year The estimated gas price The efficiency in miles per gallon The estimated resale value after 5 years Compute the total cost of owning the car for five years.

dafny.method_signature: hybrid_car_cost(new_car_cost: real, miles_per_year: real, gas_price: real, mpg: real, resale_value: real) returns (total_cost: real)
